biotools.summary: rcsb-api is a Python toolkit designed to facilitate access and usage of RCSB Protein Data Bank APIs, streamlining data retrieval and analysis for researchers in structural biology, bioinformatics, and related fields. It provides a user-friendly interface for interacting with PDB data and is available on GitHub and PyPI.
